title: gentiana scabrida subsp. luzoniensis
intro: Gentiana scabrida subsp. luzoniensis, commonly known as Luzon gentian, is a plant species belonging to the Gentianaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Gentiana scabrida subsp. luzoniensis include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including gentiopicroside, loganic acid, and swertiamarin, which are known to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
